snippet.title: Don't! Fret - Official Gameplay Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Don't! Fret is a stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights. Watch the Don't! Fret trailer to see puzzles, gameplay, and its nightmarish world. The trailer also reveals Don't! Fret's voice cast, including Amanda Hufford, Cami Cat, CG5, ChewieCatt, DaddyPhatSnaps, Dapper Mr. Tom, Fabvl, Ghostlike, Jakeneutron, Kathy Chan, LongestSoloEver, Mix Williams, NemRaps, Rochelle Diamante, Rockit, The Stupendium, and Toasymarshmellow. Don't! Fret will be available on Xbox and PC via Steam.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
